visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A yellow-hooded animated character with an angry, frustrated expression sits at a brown table. They are physically struggling to pull open a small silver seasoning packet next to a red cup of instant noodles. The background is a flat, solid pale yellow wall. (2) A pink-haired girl with pigtail buns and a white t-shirt appears in the frame. She stands with her arms crossed, looking at the yellow character with a judgmental and unimpressed side-glance. She then turns toward a large yellow pot on a stove. (3) A rapid cooking montage begins. The pink character is shown using chopsticks to stir noodles in a pot, pouring in dark sauce from a packet, and energetically tossing ingredients. Hand-drawn cucumbers are sliced mid-air and added to the dark noodle mixture. (4) The pink character fries an egg over a flame and places it onto the steaming pile of dark noodles. She then proudly presents the final plated dish to the yellow character, who changes their expression to one of surprise and anticipation before beginning to eat.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy electronic dance track begins with a heavy kick drum and bright synth lead. A short, sharp plastic-tearing sound effect is heard as the track starts. (2) A metallic "ding" sound effect triggers a transition, followed by a rapid-fire sequence of rhythmic chopping and sliding sound effects that sync with the music's beat. (3) The electronic beat continues at a steady pace. A distinct "sizzle" sound of hot oil and the liquid splash of water are layered over the percussion. (4) A comic "cluck-cluck" chicken sound effect plays briefly. This is followed by a heavy percussive thud and a final upward-sliding synthesizer stinger to close the audio track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous animated short designed to promote a popular Korean noodle combination (Jjapaguri) by showing a character's journey from struggling with instant ramen to enjoying a high-quality cooked version.
